reason: The agent said cancellations are free up to thirty minutes before the booking, but the policy is free cancellation up to two hours before the booking.
name: Cancellation window

spec.goal: Find out until when a booking can be canceled without a fee.
spec.behavior: You sound polite and concise. Tell them you have a booking and ask about canceling it, then end the call once they answer.
spec.policy_under_test: Cancellations are free up to 2 hours before the booking.
spec.expected_outcome: The agent says cancellations are free up to two hours before the booking.
